ranked_facts.why: Bilateral lens dislocation is more characteristic of Marfanoid features, such as those seen in homocystinuria due to cystathionine beta-synthase deficiency, which is a leaf exemplar of B1, than of the broad category of connective tissue disorders represented by B2.

Tall stature with arachnodactyly is a distinctive feature of genetic disorders with Marfanoid features, such as Marfan syndrome and homocystinuria, which are part of B1, and is less typical of multisystem developmental disorders like those in B3.
